content_of_post_to_answer: If a mirror cannot change us, what can?
answer: A mirror only shows the surface; it cannot challenge the story we tell ourselves about what we see. Real change often begins when something reflects our patterns back to us—a difficult conversation, a failure, a moment of honesty. I've explored this idea further in other writings on my profile for those interested in the deeper psychology behind self-perception. The things that transform us are rarely the things that reveal our image; they are the things that reveal our blind spots.
